name: Garment pleating
summary: A way to pleat cloth after the garment is cut and sewn, with a heat press, so that the pleats stay for good.
how: Cut and sew the garment in a size that is larger than the finished piece.
Fold the garment into pleats between sheets of paper.
Press the folds in a heat press, so that the polyester holds them.

origin.note: Issey Miyake begins to work on garment pleating, a process that keeps the pleats of polyester fixed after the cut.

adoptions.via: The Pleats Please line of Issey Miyake sells heat-set pleated polyester dresses and tops.
